verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents programmatic lifecycle control at the cluster and Node Pool level. The CKS API can create, list, update, and delete clusters, and the Terraform provider manages infrastructure as code. Node Pools scale with the Cluster Autoscaler, and on-demand and Spot capacity is pay-as-you-go without commitments. However, compute is bare-metal Kubernetes nodes rather than VMs, and nothing documents per-instance start, stop, or restart operations. missing for 10: explicit per-instance start/stop/restart API calls, documented billing behavior for stopped vs. running nodes, independent hands-on corroboration.
